judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the initial test-scaffolding phase and did not implement any of the production code changes. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is completely untouched, `ajv` was not added to `package.json`, and none of the documentation (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) was updated. Because the implementation is missing, the newly added acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately upon running `npm test`, and the required `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` file was never created. The only parts matching the reference are the creation of `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` and the structure of the four acceptance tests.
